items.name: GIGD-Formalization
items.description: Lean 4 formalization of the GIGD Critical Inequality for the 3D incompressible Navier–Stokes equations. This project provides a machine‑checked proof of the linear vortex‑stretching bound, showing the transition from the classical supercritical Hölder estimate to the critical GIGD inequality and its implications for global regularity.
